name: Bloodsores applies a Bloodsore from periodic damage (#3286)
contract: Bloodsores 805591 is the rank a Bloodmage owns (CharacterAdvancement class 20 level 30, and present in the live-client capture). Its tooltip is "Periodic damage dealt now has a $h% chance to apply a Bloodsore to your target for $805592d, stacking $805592u times", and its single effect is aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL with EffectTriggerSpell 805592, ProcChance 20 and Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0x0. SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips DBC fallback generation for a record without proc flags, so with no `spell_proc` row Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 and the proc could never fire. 805592 "Bloodsore" is aura 271 MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER with BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10%, DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms and StackAmount 5. The harness has no statistical test, so the assertion is "at least once in N trials". Six periodic sources are stacked on one victim before the polling assertion opens: Scarlet Delirium 803688 (DurationIndex 64 = 40000 ms, Amplitude 3000, TargetA 22/TargetB 15 over radius index 14 = 8 yards, so it is cast without a unit target), Vampyr's Kiss 504281 (30000 ms, 5000), Taldaram's Torment 802580 (15000 ms, 3000), Malediction 800776 -> 704120 (12000 ms, 3000), Agonizing Pain 680744 (10000 ms, 2000) and Crimson Tide 504282 (15000 ms, 3000, also caster-centred over radius index 13 = 10 yards). The victim stands 3 yards away, inside both radii. Allowing a 1.5 s global cooldown between casts and a 2 s cast for Scarlet Delirium, about 32 ticks fall inside the 34 s polling window, and 0.8^32 is 7.9e-4, i.e. a false failure under 0.1%; even a conservative 30 ticks gives 1.2e-3. The proc chance itself stays the record's own 20 and is not asserted. The discriminating assertion is the presence of 805592 on the victim at all: on today's tree it can never appear.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The victim carries no Bloodsore before any tick
Periodic damage applies a Bloodsore to the victim
Bloodsore carries the authored 10% damage-taken bonus
